## ElevenLabs Music API

ElevenLabs Music is a music generation model by ElevenLabs, available on the Venice API as `elevenlabs-music`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

High-quality instrumental music generation with configurable duration. Best for polished, production-ready tracks across a wide range of genres.

### ElevenLabs Music API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `elevenlabs-music` | Standard | Anonymized | $0.69 / min |

### ElevenLabs Music specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | ElevenLabs |
| Released | Feb 22, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |

### How to use the ElevenLabs Music API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/queue` with `"model": "elevenlabs-music"` and your API key.

```bash
# 1. Queue the job
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "elevenlabs-music",
    "prompt": "Warm lo-fi hip hop beat with soft piano and vinyl crackle",
    "duration_seconds": 30
  }'

# 2. Retrieve when ready
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/retrieve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "model": "elevenlabs-music", "queue_id": "<queue_id>" }' --output audio.mp3
```
